entities.name: Global Death Penalty Abolition Movement
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: As of 2024, 112 countries have abolished the death penalty. The EU requires abolition for membership. The US retains it in 27 states but executions have declined 80% since the 1990s. China, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and the US carry out the most executions. The trend is clearly toward abolition.
